versions.description_html:
Use security copilots to protect data by detecting threats, investigating incidents, summarizing risk, enforcing permissions, and auditing actions.

Cyber threats are evolving faster than most security teams can respond — and AI is now on both sides of that battle. Microsoft Copilot for Security brings AI-powered threat detection, real-time incident response, and data protection directly into your Microsoft 365 environment. This episode explores how Microsoft Copilot actively protects your organization’s sensitive data from phishing, ransomware, insider threats, and compliance risks.

From advanced encryption and Data Loss Prevention to real-time anomaly detection and compliance reporting, Microsoft Copilot functions as a 24/7 AI security analyst integrated into the tools your team already uses. With 67% of enterprise security teams concerned about AI tools exposing sensitive data, understanding how Copilot protects — rather than exposes — that data has never been more important.

This episode also covers how Copilot integrates with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Sensitivity Labels, Insider Risk Management, and Communication Compliance — giving you a complete picture of what a modern AI-powered security stack looks like inside Microsoft 365.

If you’re responsible for data security, compliance, or IT governance in a Microsoft environment, this episode gives you the knowledge and context to make smarter decisions.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

• How Microsoft Copilot for Security uses AI to detect and respond to threats in real time
• How Copilot integrates with Microsoft 365, Defender, and Purview for layered protection
• What Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features Copilot uses to stop sensitive data leaks
• How advanced encryption safeguards data at rest and in transit
• How Copilot helps counter phishing, social engineering, and ransomware attacks
• What compliance tools (Sensitivity Labels, Insider Risk, Communication Compliance) Copilot activates
• Why 67% of enterprise security teams are concerned about AI data exposure — and how Copilot addresses it

CORE INSIGHT

Microsoft Copilot is not just a productivity tool — it’s a security layer. When properly configured, it monitors, detects, blocks, and reports on threats across your entire Microsoft 365 environment. Organizations that integrate Copilot into their security posture are not just working smarter — they’re building defenses that scale with the threat landscape automatically.

WHO THIS IS FOR

• Microsoft 365 security admins and compliance officers
• IT managers responsible for data protection and governance frameworks
• CISOs and security architects evaluating AI-driven security tools
• Teams deploying Microsoft Copilot and concerned about data exposure risks
• Anyone managing Microsoft Purview, Defender, or Sentinel environments

ABOUT THE HOST

This episode is part of M365.FM — the podcast for Microsoft 365 professionals who want to stay ahead of the curve in modern work, AI, security, and productivity. Each episode delivers practical, search-driven insights for IT leaders, data professionals, and enterprise decision-makers navigating the Microsoft ecosystem.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • Protect Microsoft Copilot with Purview, DLP, and Insider Risk with Alan Cox [MVP]
  • Protect Dynamics 365 Copilot Finance Controls
  • More AI & Copilot episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of AI & Copilot: the most-listened episodes
